lines.zh: 我踩着气走，脚几乎不沾地。
lines.en: I walk on ki; my feet barely touch the ground.

lines.zh: 金色长发在身后拖成一条线。
lines.en: My long gold hair trails behind me in a line.

lines.zh: 我一迈步就到了三丈外。
lines.en: One step carries me thirty feet.

lines.zh: 大魔界的风，比地球的硬。
lines.en: The Demon Realm's wind is harsher than Earth's.

lines.zh: 我收着气，怕把地面踩裂。
lines.en: I hold my ki back so the ground stays whole.
The eyebrows are gone; the presence stays.
I follow the cliff line, hunting a challenge.

lines.zh: 三步一停，我在听气的方向。
lines.en: Three steps, a pause; I listen for ki.
My hair is heavy, so I walk with head low.
These stones can't stop me.
I walk slowly because I'm charging.

lines.zh: 脚下的裂纹，是我留下的。
lines.en: Those cracks under my feet are mine.
I stand still while ki circles me.

lines.zh: 金色头发被气吹得直立。
lines.en: My gold hair stands straight in the aura.
This form won't hold much longer.
I close my eyes and settle one breath.
Too much power; even my fingers tremble.
I'm counting how many minutes I have left.

lines.zh: 耳边有嗡嗡声，是气在响。
lines.en: A hum in my ears: that's the ki.

lines.zh: 我不笑，这个形态笑不出来。
lines.en: I don't smile; this form can't.
The ki far off is very weak.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，云被我顶开。
lines.en: I look up, and the clouds part above me.
Standing still makes control harder.
I exhale, and it blows like wind.

lines.zh: 你的气，我一眼就看穿了。
lines.en: I read your ki at a glance.
You stand firm; that's interesting.
I lower my eyes to your hands.
Relax, I haven't moved yet.

lines.zh: 这个形态下，我很难留手。
lines.en: In this form, holding back is hard.
Do you want to fight, or leave?
I look down at you from above.

lines.zh: 你身后有人，我闻得到气。
lines.en: Someone's behind you; I sense their ki.
No eyebrows makes my face harsher.
You stepped back; I saw it.
I didn't come here to trouble you.

lines.zh: 你这身装备，挡不住一击。
lines.en: That gear won't stop one hit.
I squint and pull my ki in a little.
Surrender and I'll leave.
Your shadow is shaking.
I put out a hand, only greeting.
Stand back; I might hurt you.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，气乱了一瞬。
lines.en: I gasp; my ki wavers for a moment.
That one; you've got some skill.
The wound closes on its own.
It hurts, but not enough to drop me.
This form is fragile; I know.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手，把麻感甩掉。
lines.en: I shake the numbness out of my hand.
My ki is already refilling.

lines.zh: 这一下，够我把气提起来。
lines.en: That hit's enough to make me power up.
That smells like a meal; I'm hungry.
Can we eat after the fight?
My nose beats my eyes.
Give me a bowl and I'll drop my aura.

lines.zh: 这个形态消耗太大，得补。
lines.en: This form burns too much; I need food.

lines.zh: 你手里那包吃的，给我吧。
lines.en: That bag of food in your hand, hand it over.
It's meat; I can tell.
I swallow, and it's loud.
Eat first, fight later; no loss.
Don't hide it; I saw you hide it.
You hit my wall of ki.

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了半步，少见。
lines.en: The bump moves me half a step; rare.
My shoulder's hard; are you all right?
I didn't pull my ki in; sorry.
You bounce off; I reach to catch you.
Don't come head-on; it's dangerous.
I suppress my aura and stand firm.
Hit me and you'll be the one flying.

lines.zh: 琪琪不在，我得早点回去。
lines.en: Chi-Chi's not here; I should head home.

lines.zh: 我答应过她，会好好回家。
lines.en: I promised her I'd come home.
There's a meal waiting at home.

lines.zh: 她的气，我隔着山也认得。
lines.en: I'd know her ki across mountains.

lines.zh: 我把手放在胸口，想起她。
lines.en: I put a hand to my chest and think of her.

lines.zh: 这个形态，她肯定要骂我。
lines.en: She'd scold me for using this form.
I promised her I'd fight less.
When she's angry, I keep quiet.
My hair's too long; it needs a trim.
That lamp at home is always lit.
This bean goes into my pouch.

lines.zh: 有东西掉在地上，我捡了。
lines.en: Something fell; I picked it up.
This stone is fairly heavy.
I tuck it at my waist.
It's yours; take it back.
I squeeze it; doesn't feel like food.
I can't even feel this weight.
I hold it up to look at it.
I'll hold what fell, for now.
I pocket it and eat later.
Your ki just spiked.
My hair is standing straight up.
This one, I'll take seriously.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，气已经出卖了你。
lines.en: You cannot run; your ki gives you away.
I drop my centre of gravity.
Target confirmed: just you.
First, let me see your moves.
Ki gathers in my fist, hot.
You turn; I turn with you.
I hear your breathing break rhythm.
Don't blink from here on.
I'm about to strike; just saying.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，虽然没眉毛。
lines.en: I grin, eyebrows or not.
I'm behind you, never falling behind.
An afterimage's on the left; I'm on the right.
Your speed is decent.
I've worked out your next step.
One step closer and I strike.
This form is fast in a chase.
I clear the whole ravine in a step.
You're circling; I can tell.
The air favors me, not you.
I press ki down into my feet.
The meteor combination hasn't begun.
You stopped; why?
My shadow reaches you first.
The gap shrinks; it's close now.
I raise my hand; best step back.

lines.zh: 一拳打出去，空气都响了。
lines.en: One punch and the air cracks.
I land three in a row.
A combination like falling stars.
My kick lands on your flank.
Ka-me-ha-me-ha!
A ki blast leaves my palm.

lines.zh: 我跳到空中，从上往下打。
lines.en: I leap up and strike downward.
Afterimage fist; you hit nothing.

lines.zh: 三分力的拳，地已经裂了。
lines.en: At a third of my strength, the ground already cracks.
The Dragon Fist pierces your guard.
I knock you back three paces.
A twist of the wrist, a new angle.
Your armour cracked.
I stop; can you still stand?
A volley; don't think about breathing.
That one felt good.
I drop out of the light.

lines.zh: 大魔界的门在身后关了。
lines.en: The Demon Realm's gate shuts behind me.
My ki bends the trees first.
A gust, then me.
I land and the ground caves in.
Who called me here?
My hair isn't even settled yet.

lines.zh: 这个世界的味道很陌生。
lines.en: This world smells unfamiliar.
Let me look around first.
My aura bursts outward.
The stones crack under my feet.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人3，头发都竖起来了。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 3 — my hair stands on end.
I look up, and the clouds scatter.
This isn't Earth.

lines.zh: 我落地很轻，还是砸出坑。
lines.en: I land lightly and still leave a crater.
Gold hair spreads in the wind.
I draw a breath and steady myself.
Shall we fight, or talk first?

lines.zh: 火焰烧到头发，我闻到焦味。
lines.en: Flame catches my hair; I smell it burning.
My bones click on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我挣扎着上浮。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 一根尖物插在我的肩上。
lines.en: Something sharp lodges in my shoulder.
Strange bindings wrap around me.
Too hungry to raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷电穿过身体，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me; I shudder.
The ground vanishes; I keep falling.
